newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia coastguards shoot Turkish fisherman.
newsitem.headline: Russia coastguards shoot Turkish fisherman.

text.p: A Turkish fisherman was badly wounded on Wednesday when Russian coastguards fired on a boat caught fishing in Georgia's Black Sea territorial waters, a Russian coastguard spokesman said.

Russian coastguard cutters, which patrol the area under an agreement with the Georgian government, were sent to intercept nine Turkish vessels spotted in the former Soviet republic's territorial waters.
All the boats fled except one, which, the spokesman said, began to execute what he called a dangerous manoeuvre.
"The coastguard boat fired warning shots ordering the Turkish vessel to stop," he said. "The poachers did not respond and the guards shot at the vessel."
The spokesman said the boat was escorted to the Georgian port of Batumi, which is the base for the Russian coastguards.
Russia has complained that violations by Turkish fishing boats have become frequent in recent months. Turkey, Russian officials say, acknowledges the infringements but can do little to stop them.
